A '''lantern''' is a hanging light source. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it cheaper.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Three iron nuggets around a [[torch]] make a lantern, instead of eight in vanilla; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/lantern.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
